timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hi, we are at Gitex Week this week and we have with us Huda Mansour, managing director of SAP Egypt.
Huda, thank you for being with us today.
So Egypt is pushing a lot of financial inclusion initiatives.
Can you share what this means for SAP and for the industry as well?
The central bank governor has announced a big fund of 1 billion Egyptian pounds
and this fund would go towards supporting startups to make sure that the Fink Tax in Egypt
have the environment and the place to collaborate and start bringing up new ideas
that could support the financial inclusion.
Financial inclusion is on the agenda of the Egyptian President.
It's part of the mandate for Vision 2030 and it's the only way for Egypt to come to the next level.
So there's a lot of technology providers who are supporting such initiative SAP also
is trying to support such initiatives working with the startups, working with the central bank
and working with the financial institutions at large.
Okay, so I've been told that the Ministry of Finance have put in place tax reforms
and the SAP is assisting them with this. Can you shed light on this?
Yes, we are very honored actually to be selected by the Ministry of Finance
to work on the tax reform program in Egypt so they have selected our technologies.
It is a very important step also to increase the income of the country.
Unfortunately at the moment there are a lot of people who are not really declaring their tax
in the right way. So the Ministry of Finance together with the President
are putting very strong measures to make sure that everyone is delivering their commitment to the
country, paying their taxes so that they can get such funds and then fuel it towards the
underprivileged citizens, citizens exactly.
So having this program with our technology, it will help a lot of people and it's part of the
national agenda of Egypt. So we're really honored to be part of that.
Okay, that sounds very good. Do you have anything else you'd like to share with us?
I wish you all the best of luck. I wish each of all the best of luck and we're there to support the
country with our technologies. Thank you very much.
It's a very good time, Nida. Thank you very much.
Thank you.
Very good morning.

youtube_description:
Established for more than a decade, Banker Middle East is the region's only monthly publication that solely caters to banking and finance since 1999. 

The magazine highlights the biggest news stories and industry developments across MENA, providing in-depth analyses on various facets of the financial services sector, as well as exclusive interviews with market leaders. 

Banker Middle East is an essential partner for brands integral to the financial services sector, including financial institutions or service providers. The magazine's circulation of 20,000 includes C-level executives both in financial institutions as well as key corporate organisations across the MENA region.
